author: OldSharpie
body:
Hi, this is the map Electron, formerly it was a DTC/DTM for OCN, but as it didn't enter the repo, I made it DTM and I am releasing it to avicus. 

There are two gold monuments, with chests with deffense stuff near them.

The map is thought for skybridging.

Overview:


More pictures here:http://imgur.com/a/heNYf

If I see some interest in this, I will run a gameplay test.
